name: Koushuu Denwa
source: After a long night of drinking, you wake up locked inside an isolated phone booth. All you have to your name are three 10-yen coins. That’s it. The only way you’re getting out is with your words. So… whom do you call?
translation: 一夜饮酒作乐后，你醒来发现自己被锁在一座偏僻的电话亭里。身上只有3枚10日元硬币，仅此而已。能否脱身，全看你如何开口。那么……你会打给谁？
